title: Kissed Tangy Russian Duck Confit
description: A tangy and juicy Russian dish featuring duck confit leg, perfect for a date night, with a raw-friendly twist. This recipe combines the richness of duck with the brightness of tangy flavors.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the duck legs and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, dill, lemon juice, apple cider vinegar, honey, salt, and black pepper.
Add the duck legs to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove the duck legs from the marinade and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the duck legs in the preheated oven for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender and falls off the bone.
Let the duck legs rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the duck confit with a side of blanched vegetables, such as asparagus or carrots, and a raw-friendly slaw made with shredded cabbage and carrots.
